# railway_project (Data Source)

A Railway project and the IDs of its environments, for wiring `environment_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "railway_project" "app" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

output "production_environment_id" {
  value = data.railway_project.app.environments["production"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Project ID.

### Read-Only

- `environments` (Map of String) Environment IDs keyed by environment name.
- `name` (String) Project name.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace that owns the project.
